description: This file contains cryptographic PEM handling functions, including reading and writing various key and certificate formats, and internal helper functions for key extraction, primarily for OpenSSL's BoringSSL fork.

methods.name: pkey_get_rsa
methods.description: Helper function to extract RSA key from EVP_PKEY.

methods.name: pkey_get_dsa
methods.description: Helper function to extract DSA key from EVP_PKEY.

methods.name: pkey_get_eckey
